weaknesses.title: DELETEALL is process-local — plate DUMPOBJ rehydrate undoes drain
weaknesses.detail: Agents must RM dump files in the same action as DELETEALL Conn. Restoring dumps after drain re-creates live objects on next ARG run. No native object plate lifetime tied to DELETEALL.
weaknesses.repro: open c0 c1; drain; restore dump/*; list → 2 conns back

weaknesses.title: Fixed slot EQS dispatch — string-var object names fail GETF/SEND
weaknesses.detail: c0/c1/c2/g0 forced as literal idents. Cannot loop slot names from bag with SEND n use.
weaknesses.repro: LET n="c0"; SEND n use → fail

weaknesses.title: SYS JOIN is path-join only (inserts /) — no string concat
weaknesses.detail: rollup label must REPLACEALL template f:F b:B s:S, not JOIN.

weaknesses.title: DUMPOBJ on EACH bind o fails (unknown object)
weaknesses.detail: Fleet dump uses HASOBJ+DUMPOBJ literal slots after EACH rollup.
weaknesses.repro: EACH OBJ Conn AS o; DUMPOBJ o → unknown object

weaknesses.title: SETMATCH replaces first exact only; no replace-all
weaknesses.detail: Three c0:use rows → one SETMATCH leaves 2. Agents loop or accept first-only.
weaknesses.repro: count after one SETMATCH drops by 1 only

weaknesses.title: TRYSEND/TRYSETF sticky last_err needs CLEAR_ERR for -s
weaknesses.detail: Soft probe leaves last_err; strict mode reports noise without CLEAR_ERR.
weaknesses.repro: TRYSEND c0 no_such; without CLEAR_ERR under -s

weaknesses.title: WRITE metas omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: cat -A VAL/JOURNAL/dump shows $ between bag lines, last line no NL.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE env softens to 0
weaknesses.detail: CUBALC_CP_REQUIRE=abc → REQUIRE_HIT stays 0 → gate deny soft rc0.

weaknesses.title: DELETEALL does not cascade to plate files or journal
weaknesses.detail: Bulk free only touches live object table. Agents must co-author RM dump + optional journal events; no atomic pool-transaction primitive.
weaknesses.repro: DELETEALL Conn alone leaves dump/c0 on disk

workarounds: drain/wipe/freeall always SYS RM dump slots after DELETEALL

Atomic pool drain transaction (memory + plate + journal)
